title: rollback-spec template variables
description: Values for templates/rollback-spec.md.j2 and templates/rollback-spec.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from rollback-spec.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

audit_log_path.title: Audit log path
audit_log_path.description: Where does this button write its audit entries - the path or URI an auditor opens without asking anyone? Step 4 is unverifiable without it.

bundle_fields.title: Bundle fields
bundle_fields.description: Which fields revert together as one atomic bundle? Anything you do not list here stays at its current value, so a field omitted by accident survives the rollback.

button_label.title: Button label
button_label.description: What exact words does the operator see on the button? Write the label, not a description of it - ambiguity here is read under time pressure at 3am.

document_version.description: Which revision of this spec is this? Bump it whenever the bundle, the immutable set or the eval gate changes - operators diff versions to explain a revert that behaved differently.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Which deployment environment does this button revert - prod, staging, a named region? One button per environment; a shared button is how a staging revert reaches production.

eval_gate_ci_width.title: Eval gate ci width
eval_gate_ci_width.description: How wide may the confidence interval around that pass-rate be before the measurement is too noisy to gate on? A wide interval passing the floor is not a pass.

eval_gate_golden_set_version.title: Eval gate golden set version
eval_gate_golden_set_version.description: Which golden-set version must the rollback target pass before the button fires? Name a pinned version, not 'latest' - a moving set makes the gate unfalsifiable.

eval_gate_min_pass_rate.title: Eval gate min pass rate
eval_gate_min_pass_rate.description: What pass-rate on that golden set is the floor the target must clear? Below it the button refuses and an override is required.

immutable_fields.title: Immutable fields
immutable_fields.description: Which fields must a revert never touch? Usually the ones carrying state produced after the bad deploy - consent records, audit rows, anything a customer has already seen.

last_reviewed_date.description: When did a human last read this spec end to end, as YYYY-MM-DD? A rollback spec nobody has reread since the bundle changed is a button that reverts the wrong fields.

owner_full_name.description: Who owns this rollback button? One named human on the ops rota who can be paged at the moment it is pressed, never a team alias.

spec_id.title: Spec id
spec_id.description: Which rollback-button spec is this? Use the same id the JSON spec and every audit-log entry carry, or the three artefacts cannot be joined after an incident.
